name: k3d in Codespace (recommended)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl jq && curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k3d-io/k3d/main/install.sh | bash && curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -L -s https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl" && chmod +x kubectl && sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/ && curl -fsSL -o get_helm.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-4 && chmod 700 get_helm.sh && ./get_helm.sh && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/helm && curl -sS https://webi.sh/k9s | sh && source ~/.config/envman/PATH.env && k3d cluster create dev --servers 1 --agents 1 -p "8080:80@loadbalancer"
